# webtables/streq

> Helper: string equality, `$__pk_streq(a, b)`: the lengths, then the bytes.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/streq.pkg)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
(func $__pk_streq (param $a i64) (param $b i64) (result i64) (local $n i32) (local $i i32) (local $p i32) (local $q i32)
(if (i64.ne (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $a))) (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $b)))) (then (return (i64.const 0))))
(local.set $n (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.load (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $a)))))
(local.set $p (i32.add (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $a)) (i32.const 8)))
(local.set $q (i32.add (i32.wrap_i64 (local.get $b)) (i32.const 8)))
(block $done (loop $next
(br_if $done (i32.ge_u (local.get $i) (local.get $n)))
(if (i32.ne (i32.load8_u (i32.add (local.get $p) (local.get $i))) (i32.load8_u (i32.add (local.get $q) (local.get $i))))
(then (return (i64.const 0))))
(local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
(br $next)))
(i64.const 1))
```
